settings.title: AI assistant
settings.description: Chat with Claude to search, summarize and update your CRM. The assistant uses the same tools as the CLI and MCP server, with your own permissions.
settings.apiKeyHelp: Create a key at console.anthropic.com. Usage is billed to your Anthropic account.
settings.cleared: API key removed from this browser.
settings.privacyTitle: Your key stays in this browser
settings.privacy: The key is saved in this browser's local storage only — never in your CRM data, config.js or git, and other users don't see it. The assistant calls the Anthropic API directly from your browser; there is no AgentCRM server in between. Each change the assistant wants to make is shown to you for approval.
